name: kaba
description: A mechanically-enforced spec-driven TDD workflow. Tests are written and locked before implementation code, and git-based gates — not prompts — enforce the boundary. Currently targets Rails/RSpec.

interface.longDescription: Write and lock tests before implementation, with git-backed gates that enforce the boundary throughout a spec-driven workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use Kaba to start a new feature in this repository.
Use Kaba to continue the active feature workflow.
